subject: Replace Phase 2 in-process monitor with DBOS workflow handoff
description:
Update `capo/tools/claude_code.py` so that after `session_id_subagent` is captured, `delegate_to_claude_code` hands off to the `monitor_delegation` DBOS workflow instead of the Phase 2 asyncio task. Remove the Phase 2 in-process monitor.

**Acceptance Criteria:**

_Functional:_
- [ ] `delegate_to_claude_code` returns the handle and starts `monitor_delegation` via `DBOS.start_workflow(monitor_delegation, delegation_id)` (or equivalent).
- [ ] Phase 2 in-process asyncio monitor removed.
- [ ] Reader continues to be owned by the workflow's `@DBOS.step` so its progress is checkpointed.
- [ ] Backwards-compatibility: existing `delegations` rows from Phase 2 testing are migrated or recreated; not a concern for fresh deploys.

_Edge Cases:_
- [ ] Workflow start failure: row marked `failed`, subprocess killed, tool returns explicit error.

**Testing Requirements:**
• Integration: `delegate_to_claude_code` returns handle BEFORE workflow body runs
• Integration: workflow takes ownership; status tool reports workflow-managed state
• Integration: no leftover Phase 2 in-process tasks after handoff

Source: internal/specs/capo-SPEC.md Sections 5.3, 5.6, 9.3
